completionDefinition: Guarded simulator, validation, and handoff are implemented as local administrator simulator-only metadata.
Simulated preflight, write lock, operation, audit, rollback, and failure handling are explicit and reviewable.
Template Workbench shows 10S simulator while Vision Analysis and ordinary user paths do not expose simulator terms.
Actual registry write, registry mutation, publish, production writer creation, production package creation, and current User App Shell package replacement remain blocked.
Documentation, provider prompts, project-state, and scoped tests are updated to 10S.
